register.name: Section 32 food purchase for food banks
register.detail: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service · announced 29 October 2026
register.text: American-grown food bought from farmers and delivered to food banks and nutrition programs: dairy, pulses, nuts, fruit, rice, pork, chicken and fish.

register.name: Healthy Food Financing Initiative, FARE Fund
register.detail: Reinvestment Fund for USDA Rural Development · 2024-25 rounds, completed 16 April 2026
register.note: $9 million in grants, $6 million in loans, $1.5 million in technical assistance
register.text: Grants and loans to 62 food retail and supply chain projects in 39 states, 30 of them rural.

register.name: Healthy Food Financing Partnerships, 2026 round
register.detail: Reinvestment Fund for USDA · opened 29 June 2026 · grants of $200,000 to $3 million
register.text: Grants to the public-private partnerships that finance grocers and food enterprises in their own state or region.

register.name: Ursa Re 2026-1 catastrophe bond
register.detail: California Earthquake Authority · marketing in November 2026 · about four years, indemnity trigger
register.note: Target raised from $600 million on 11 November 2026
register.text: Fully collateralized earthquake reinsurance from capital market investors for California’s earthquake insurer.

register.name: Pennsylvania Fresh Food Financing Initiative
register.detail: Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and Reinvestment Fund · 2004 to 2010
register.note: State seed money, leveraged with $145 million in additional investment
register.text: Loans and grants for 88 fresh food retail projects in underserved urban and rural communities; the model for the national Healthy Food Financing Initiative.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Farmland
items.label: Of the land in agriculture, 2023
items.text: Land that can feed the nation and earn abroad, valued and financed against its harvest.

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of the land under forest, 2024
items.text: Standing forest that stores carbon and water, and can earn as it stands.

items.name: The Fresh Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water a person, 2022
items.text: Rain and rivers renewed every year: power, irrigation and drinking water.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025

items.name: The Oil and Gas
items.label: Of GDP from oil and gas rents, 2021
items.text: Oil and gas already earn; the task is to turn the rent into assets that outlast it.
